sources.observations: Three giant segmental arches spanning two storeys; rusticated piers, cream painted sash/spandrel panels, four ground shops. Canopy edge hides roof in this view.
Chamfered corner with narrow window, full arch on Stanley return, red brick strip with two narrow windows; pink Treat Street frontage, surviving glazed canopy.
Entrance number 2, silver horizontal extraction duct, drainpipes, low wall and closed gate into narrow yard. Upper rear brick/window groups partly visible; private yard not entered.

Actual photogrammetric mesh loaded using Globe view. Captures at headings 0,90,180,270 around 87 m altitude resolve asymmetric roof: broad shallow membrane front slope, steep slate rear pitch, hipped Stanley end; rear yard separates neighbouring Willow Grove service tower.
Retained seed in block layout. Rectangular seed requires observed corner chamfer; approximate 16.7 by 11.35 metre extent.
Business-owned booking page identifies 18 Nevill Street.
1888 Hurst and Bolshaw business premises on Nevill/Stanley corner, separate office/cellar approach from Stanley. Attribution provisional pending matching historic illustration.
Townscape historic context; image search for 18–22 Nevill yielded mostly unrelated Australian Southport and 42–50 Nevill. No useful additional current roof photography.
